criterion: per file, the container decoded (SFNT, TTC, WOFF, WOFF2), then every table the package parses, fonts.read, every glyph and every CharString of a name-keyed CFF table, all steps run even after a typed refusal of another; ok when it returns or throws an error of the package's own hierarchy (FontError) within the budget; a failure is an untyped throw, a hang, memory past the cap or a crash of the child
budget: 10 s per case for an input up to 10 MB, plus 1 s per further MB (hard cap twice the budget); 1 GiB peak memory
